sentences.en: OK, are you all settled?
sentences.zh: OK，大家坐好了吗？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, welcome to Cardiff University.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，欢迎来到卡迪夫大学。

sentences.en: I'm here to explain what we can offer you.
sentences.zh: 我在这里为大家介绍学校能为你们提供哪些服务。

sentences.en: Now, as a new student at the university, you will probably need some sort of guidance to help you to use the library effectively to study and research.
sentences.zh: 作为大学的新生，你们很可能需要某种指导，以帮助你们高效地利用图书馆进行学习和研究。

sentences.en: Some of you have asked about a guided tour but we find this rather muddles people.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人曾询问过导览参观的事，但我们发现这种方式反而容易让人感到混乱。

sentences.en: So, in this first week, we run a series of talks which focus on different aspects of the library and its resources.
sentences.zh: 因此，在第一周，我们会举办一系列讲座，分别聚焦于图书馆及其资源的不同方面。

sentences.en: You'll also find that to get the most out of the library you really do need to be computer literate and so all this term we run small classes which will bring you up to speed on how to access the computer-loaded information.
sentences.zh: 此外，你们会发现，要想充分利用图书馆，确实需要具备一定的计算机素养；因此，本学期我们开设了若干小型课程，帮助你们快速掌握如何访问计算机化信息。

sentences.en: OK, now let me give you an outline of what's available to you.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在让我为大家简要介绍一下你们可以使用的服务。

sentences.en: You'll find that the computers are increasingly used as a research tool.
sentences.zh: 你们会发现，计算机正日益被用作一种研究工具。

sentences.en: Many students do most of their research on the internet and the library computers are permanently online.
sentences.zh: 许多学生主要通过互联网开展研究，而图书馆的计算机则始终保持在线状态。

sentences.en: Having found what you need, you'll find you can readily save texts on your personal computer space to print off when you need.
sentences.zh: 在找到所需资料后，你们可以轻松地将文本保存到个人电脑空间中，并在需要时打印出来。

sentences.en: You might think that it is the fastest way to get information but the links can be slow.
sentences.zh: 你们或许会觉得这是获取信息最快的方式，但网络链接有时却很慢。

sentences.en: Clearly you can find lots on there but much of it is useless information as it is.
sentences.zh: 显然，网上信息量巨大，但其中很多内容本身并无实际价值。

sentences.en: from highly debatable sources - So be critical.
sentences.zh: ——这些信息往往源自极富争议的来源，因此请务必保持批判性思维。

sentences.en: You'll also find that the library has loaded several CD-ROMS onto the computers from specialist reference sources such as the MLA.
sentences.zh: 你们还会发现，图书馆已将若干CD-ROM光盘加载至计算机中，其内容来自MLA等专业参考资源。

sentences.en: It means we can expand what we offer you at very little extra cost and saves us having to invest in more and more books.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们能以极低的额外成本扩展所提供的服务，同时避免不断采购越来越多的图书。

sentences.en: The CD-ROMS contain exactly the same information as the reference books as the two are updated together.
sentences.zh: 这些CD-ROM光盘所含信息与纸质参考书完全相同，且两者同步更新。

sentences.en: Now most of you will need to refer to journal articles in your work and you'll find you can also access these online and we encourage you to do so.
sentences.zh: 现在，你们中的大多数人将在作业中引用期刊文章，而你们同样可在线获取这些文章，我们也鼓励你们这样做。

sentences.en: Clearly some of you will find the printed version more accessible as it sits on the shelves but 034 I'm afraid the intention is to phase these out eventually.
sentences.zh: 显然，部分同学可能觉得印刷版更易获取，因为它们就陈列在书架上；但遗憾的是，我们的计划是最终逐步淘汰这些印刷版。

sentences.en: However, you will still be able to print off a version of the text rather than photocopying the journal pages.
sentences.zh: 不过，你们仍可将文本打印出来，而不必影印期刊页面。

sentences.en: So you must get used to working online.
sentences.zh: 因此，你们必须习惯在线工作。

sentences.en: Naturally we do still have the full range of classic reference books, additional to the CD-ROMS, for you to use and there are several copies of each one.
sentences.zh: 当然，除CD-ROM光盘外，我们依然保有全套经典参考书籍供你们使用，且每种书籍均有多个副本。

sentences.en: This is because some of you may prefer to borrow a book rather than sit in the library.
sentences.zh: 这是因为你们中有些人可能更愿意借阅图书，而非在图书馆内阅读。

sentences.en: There is a restricted loan time on these so that they are not missing from the shelves for too long.
sentences.zh: 这些图书设有严格的借阅时限，以免长期缺架。

sentences.en: Although there is a Section Manager for each part of the library, they are very busy and so, if you do get stuck looking for things, you should ask the relevant Cataloguing Assistant.
sentences.zh: 尽管图书馆每个区域均配有分区主管，但他们工作非常繁忙；因此，若你们在查找资料时遇到困难，应向相应的编目助理寻求帮助。

sentences.en: As your Training Supervisor, Ljust oversce your induction and will not be around after this initial week.
sentences.zh: 作为你们的培训主管，Ljust负责监督你们的入职培训，但仅限于这最初的这一周。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Some of you may be interested to know that the library is offering specialised training 7.5000 sessions on writing a dissertation.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 你们中有些人可能感兴趣的是，图书馆正提供关于撰写学位论文的专项培训，共7500场次。

sentences.en: Obviously this is not relevant to those of you who are •Sage.com undergraduates; it is just for postgraduates.
sentences.zh: 显然，这对本科生并不适用；该培训仅面向研究生。

sentences.en: Your department will discuss the planning stage of the dissertation - i.e. what you're going to do with you and we will focus on the structure of it.
sentences.zh: 你们的院系将在论文规划阶段——即明确你们将要开展的工作——与你们进行讨论，而我们将侧重于论文结构的指导。

sentences.en: However, the training will also include some time on the computers.
sentences.zh: 不过，该培训还将包含一部分计算机操作内容。

sentences.en: realise most of you know how to organise files but we can show you the different ways to run data programmes.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到，你们中的大多数人都懂得如何组织文件，但我们可以向你们展示运行数据程序的不同方法。

sentences.en: Your tutors will tell you at the outset how to set out the chapters they require but you will need to ask them how they would like you to organise the bibliography because it varies depending on your subject area.
sentences.zh: 导师们会在一开始便告知你们所需章节的格式要求，但你们需主动询问他们希望你们如何组织参考文献，因为不同学科领域的要求各不相同。

sentences.en: When you've got something together the trainer here will look through the draft version for you to see if it's OK.
sentences.zh: 当你们完成初稿后，这里的培训师将帮你们审阅草稿，确认是否符合要求。

sentences.en: And, one final point, for those of you who have registered from abroad, we can offer individual sessions on dissertations if you feel you need them.
sentences.zh: 最后再补充一点：对于从海外注册入学的同学，如你们感觉有需要，我们可提供一对一的学位论文辅导。

sentences.en: If you require language lessons then they are available from the International Centre next to the Law Department.
sentences.zh: 若你们需要语言课程，可前往法学院旁的国际中心报名。

sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com +。

sentences.zh: SARg 答案解析 TopSage.com
